name: feature-grid
useFor: Use for three to six capabilities of equal weight. One column on a phone, two on a tablet, three on wide screens (`columns={2}` keeps two). Keep each description to one sentence and the value to a few mono words.
constraints: Cards with gaps instead of shared rules
Hover fills on cells that are not links
source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): feature-rows.css and coverage-grid (cells on 1px rules, mono labels)
title: Feature grid
description: Features on a survey grid: cells share 1px Stone rules, each with a 20px glyph, a mono index, a 16px title, a muted line and a mono value.
